mapper.sql: saved.id AS saved_id, saved.saved_at, program.source_code, program.source_program_id, program.title, program.organization, program.summary, program.categories, program.regions, program.target_description, program.application_period_raw, program.application_start_date, program.application_end_date, program.source_url, program.source_sort_timestamp, program.startup_details
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM saved_support_program saved JOIN support_program program ON program.id = saved.support_program_id WHERE saved.account_id = #{accountId} AND program.is_source_present = TRUE ORDER BY saved.saved_at DESC, saved.id DESC
